text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval of the collective agreement with IATSE Local 822 for the Sony Centre for the Performing Arts.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the collective agreement with IATSE Local 822 for the Sony Centre for the Performing Arts, as outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 5, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (December 5, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about labour relations or employee negotiations.
